title: Where the LIFX HomeKit and Matter codes are
description: LIFX prints the HomeKit code as HK: ###-##-### on the light, below the serial on most models, and on the back of the manual. Matter lights have a Matter QR.
lede: LIFX labels the HomeKit code with HK: so you can tell it from the serial number, and lists where it sits on every product.

rows.text: Printed on the back of the product manual and on the product, marked HK: ###-##-###. A19, Mini and GU10: below the serial number. BR30: to the right of the serial number, under the rubber seal. Lightstrip and Beam: on the back of the controller. Tile: on the master tile only. Downlight: etched on the casing.
Exists only for lights that shipped without a code: Light Settings, HomeKit Status, PAIR, GET CODE in the LIFX app. It does not apply to lights that shipped with one.
Look for the QR code with the Matter logo and an 11 digit code. LIFX: save it before installation, especially for hard to reach fixtures.

LIFX app, Light Settings, Share Device with another service. iOS generates a Matter setup code. Android hands the light over without a code, except when sharing to an iOS ecosystem, where a code is generated and scanned.

sources.label: LIFX: share Matter devices across platforms
